name: long_horizon_recall
description: Tests whether the policy retrieves information from early turns when asked about it many turns later.

tasks.input: The project name is PEP, which stands for Predictive Encoding and Preparation.
PEP has three primitives: prediction, reactivation, and residuals.
The theoretical backbone is PTO: Potential Transformation Output.
Tell me about something unrelated, like chess openings.
What are the best Italian restaurants in the area?
How does photosynthesis work in desert plants?
